correctness.rationale: Fonarev--Kuznetsov give a smooth projective G_m-variety with isolated fixed points and prove equality, in every dimension d, between its Bialynicki--Birula cells and the Schubert cells of Gr(k,2n+2-k). Brosnan Theorem 3.5 is integral and identifies the Chow motive with the direct sum of the fixed-component motives twisted by the positive-weight dimensions. With isolated fixed points this is exactly a direct sum of Z(d) with those cell multiplicities. The ordinary Grassmannian has the matching cellular decomposition. Grothendieck-class equality follows independently by additivity over affine cells.

value.rationale: The source's equality of Betti groups is lifted to an integral Chow-motive isomorphism, giving cycle-theoretic and realization-level information rather than only topology. The companion Grothendieck-class identity is a natural motivic refinement forced by the same cell comparison. This is structurally meaningful while respecting the unresolved multiplicative problem.
